exemple.de: Die <mark>Statuten</mark> müssen Bestimmungen enthalten über: 1. die Firma und den Sitz der Gesellschaft; 2. den Zweck der Gesellschaft; 3. die Höhe und die Währung des Aktienkapitals sowie den Betrag der darauf geleisteten Einlagen; 4. Anzahl, Nennwert und Art der Aktien; 5. und 6. … 7. die Form der Mitteilungen der Gesellschaft an ihre Aktionäre.
exemple.fr: Les <mark>statuts</mark> doivent contenir des dispositions sur: 1. la raison sociale et le siège de la société; 2. le but de la société; 3. le montant du capital-actions, la monnaie dans laquelle il est fixé et le montant des apports effectués; 4. le nombre, la valeur nominale et l’espèce des actions; 5. et 6. … 7. la forme des communications de la société à ses actionnaires.
exemple.it: Lo <mark>statuto</mark> deve contenere disposizioni sui punti seguenti: 1. la ditta e la sede della società; 2. lo scopo della società; 3. l’ammontare e la moneta del capitale azionario, nonché l’ammontare dei conferimenti effettuati; 4. il numero, il valore nominale e la specie delle azioni; 5. e 6. … 7. la forma delle comunicazioni della società agli azionisti.
exemple.en: The <mark>articles of association</mark> must contain provisions concerning: 1. the business name and seat of the company; 2. the objects of the company; 3. the total share capital, its currency, and the extent to which it is paid up; 4. the number, nominal value and types of shares; 5. and 6. ... 7. the form of the company’s communications with its shareholders.

resume: The capital of a company limited by shares, divided into shares and set out in the articles of association.
lead: The share capital of a Swiss company limited by shares is at least CHF 100,000. Since 2023, it has also been possible to set it in a foreign currency that is important for the company's business operations.
definition: The share capital is the capital set out in the articles of association of a company limited by shares and divided into shares. It must be at least CHF 100,000; since the revision of the law on companies limited by shares, which came into force on 1 January 2023, it may also be denominated in a foreign currency. On foundation, each share must be paid up to at least 20% of its nominal value and the contributions must amount to a total of at least 50,000 francs.
title: Aktienkapital: share capital · Neur.on
description: Aktienkapital, share capital, capital azionario, share capital: the capital of the Swiss stock corporation pursuant to art. 621 CO.

exemple.de: Das <mark>Aktienkapital</mark> beträgt mindestens 100 000 Franken.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>capital-actions</mark> ne peut être inférieur à 100 000 francs.
exemple.it: Il <mark>capitale azionario</mark> non può essere inferiore a 100 000 franchi.
exemple.en: The <mark>share capital</mark> amounts to at least 100,000 francs.

resume: The public register that records the rights to immovable property.
lead: In Switzerland, ownership of immovable property is generally acquired by entry in the land register. The register is open to the public and protects those relying on it in good faith.
definition: Le registre foncier donne l'état des droits sur les immeubles. Il comprend le grand livre, les documents complémentaires (plan, rôle, pièces justificatives, état descriptif) et le journal. La propriété et les autres droits réels immobiliers s'acquièrent en principe par l'inscription, et celui qui acquiert de bonne foi en se fondant sur une inscription est protégé. Toute personne qui fait valoir un intérêt peut consulter le registre.
title: Grundbuch: the Swiss land register · Neur.on
description: Grundbuch, Land Register, Registro Fondiario, Land Register: the Register of immovable Property Rights (Art. 942 CC).

exemple.de: Über die Rechte an den Grundstücken wird ein <mark>Grundbuch</mark> geführt.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>registre foncier</mark> donne l’état des droits sur les immeubles.
exemple.it: È istituito un <mark>registro</mark> dei diritti sui fondi.
exemple.en: The <mark>land register</mark> is kept as a record of property rights.

resume: The share of the estate that certain heirs are guaranteed by law and cannot be deprived of by the deceased.
lead: Pflichtteil says it is reserved in Swiss French. Since 1 January 2023, the statutory entitlement has been smaller: the issue have only half of their statutory entitlement and the parents no longer have such entitlement.
definition: The statutory entitlement is the portion of the estate that certain heirs cannot be deprived of by will or contract of succession, unless they are disinherited. Since the revision of inheritance law, which came into force on 1 January 2023, the statutory entitlement of the issue, such as that of the surviving spouse or registered partner, has been one-half of their inheritance rights, and the parents no longer have any statutory entitlement. The remainder constitutes the disposable part of the estate, which the deceased may freely dispose of.
title: Pflichtteil: the Swiss inheritance reserve · Neur.on
description: Pflichtteil, Reserve, porzione legittima, entitlement statutory: the share of estate guaranteed by art. 470 and 471 CC.

exemple.de: Der <mark>Pflichtteil</mark> beträgt die Hälfte des gesetzlichen Erbanspruchs.
exemple.fr: La <mark>réserve</mark> est de la moitié du droit de succession.
exemple.it: La <mark>porzione legittima</mark> è della metà della quota ereditaria.
exemple.en: The <mark>statutory entitlement</mark> is one-half of the statutory succession rights.

resume: The testator instructs the testator to execute his or her will.
lead: The executor is appointed by will. It manages the estate and conducts it until the estate is divided, under the supervision of the authority.
definition: By testamentary disposition, the testator may entrust one or more persons with capacity to act with the execution of his or her last will and testament. The executor is informed ex officio of his mandate and has fourteen days to accept it. It manages the estate, pays the debts, pays the legacies and divides the estate in accordance with the deceased's instructions or the law. He is entitled to appropriate compensation.
title: Willensvollstrecker: the executor of the will · Neur.on
description: Willensvollstrecker, executor, esecutore testamentario, executor: his appointment and powers (Art. 517 and 518 CC).

exemple.de: Die <mark>Willensvollstrecker</mark> stehen, soweit der Erblasser nichts anderes verfügt, in den Rechten und Pflichten des amtlichen Erbschaftsverwalters.
exemple.fr: Si le disposant n’en a ordonné autrement, les <mark>exécuteurs testamentaires</mark> ont les droits et les devoirs de l’administrateur officiel d’une succession.
exemple.it: Salvo contraria disposizione del testatore, gli <mark>esecutori testamentari</mark> hanno gli stessi diritti e doveri dell’amministratore ufficiale di una successione.
exemple.en: Unless otherwise provided by the testator, the <mark>executors</mark> have the same rights and duties as an official estate administrator.

source: Fedlex, debt enforcement and bankruptcy Act
resume: The court's decision rejects the debtor's objection and allows the enforcement proceedings to continue.
lead: After an opposition to the summons to pay, the debt enforcement proceedings are suspended. Final or provisional lifting of the objection is the quick way to unblock it.
definition: Where the debtor has filed an objection to the summons to pay, the creditor may request that the summons be set aside. A final release from liability is granted to the creditor on the basis of an enforceable judgment or equivalent document. Provisional release from liability is granted if debt enforcement proceedings are based on an officially recorded or privately executed acknowledgement of debt, unless the debtor provides prima facie evidence of his release. The court decides in summary proceedings.
title: Rechtsöffnung: lifting the opposition · Neur.on
description: Rechtsöffnung, lifting of the objection, rigetto dell' opposizione, setting aside of an objection: the final or provisional lifting of the DEBA.

exemple.de: Beruht die Forderung auf einem vollstreckbaren gerichtlichen Entscheid, so kann der Gläubiger beim Richter die Aufhebung des Rechtsvorschlags (definitive <mark>Rechtsöffnung</mark>) verlangen.
exemple.fr: Le créancier qui est au bénéfice d’un jugement exécutoire peut requérir du juge la <mark>mainlevée</mark> définitive de l’opposition.
exemple.it: Se il credito è fondato su una decisione giudiziaria esecutiva, il creditore può chiedere in giudizio il <mark>rigetto</mark> definitivo dell’opposizione.
exemple.en: If the claim is based on an enforceable court judgment, the creditor may request the court to dismiss the objection to the summons for payment (<mark>setting aside the objection</mark> definitively).

source: Fedlex, debt enforcement and bankruptcy Act
resume: The time limit set by the court for a debtor in difficulty to rectify his or her situation or to conclude a composition agreement.
lead: A debt restructuring moratorium is the restructuring tool under Swiss law: it protects the debtor from debt enforcement proceedings while negotiating with his creditors under the supervision of an administrator.
definition: The debtor or a creditor entitled to apply for bankruptcy may apply to the composition court for a debt restructuring moratorium. The court shall first grant a temporary stay of up to four months and appoint an administrator. The definitive suspension is then granted for four to six months, and may be extended to twelve months or even twenty-four months in particularly complex cases. During the suspension of enforcement, no enforcement proceedings may in principle be initiated or continued against the debtor.
title: Nachlassstundung: debt restructuring moratorium · Neur.on
description: Nachlassstundung, moratoria concordataria, debt restructuring moratorium: the composition procedure under the DEBA.

exemple.de: Wurde vor der Bewilligung der <mark>Nachlassstundung</mark> die Abtretung einer künftigen Forderung vereinbart, entfaltet diese Abtretung keine Wirkung, wenn die Forderung erst nach der Bewilligung der Nachlassstundung entsteht.
exemple.fr: La cession de créance future conclue avant l’octroi d’un <mark>sursis concordataire</mark> ne déploie pas d’effets si la créance cédée prend naissance après l’octroi du sursis.
exemple.it: La cessione di crediti futuri convenuta prima della concessione della <mark>moratoria concordataria</mark> non esplica alcun effetto se il credito nasce dopo tale concessione.
exemple.en: If the assignment of a future claim was agreed before the <mark>composition moratorium</mark> was authorised, this assignment shall have no effect if the claim only arises after the composition moratorium was authorised.

resume: The measures that the court orders before or during the proceedings to protect a threatened right.
lead: Interim measures protect a right before the court decides on the merits. In cases of particular urgency, they may be ordered without hearing the opposing party.
definition: The court shall order the necessary interim measures if the applicant shows credibly that a claim of which he is the holder is the subject of or is at risk of being infringed and that such infringement is likely to cause him damage which is difficult to remedy. In particular, it may order a prohibition order, an end to an unlawful situation or a custodial measure. In cases of particular urgency, it may order them immediately, without hearing the opposing party.
title: Vorsorgliche Massnahmen: precautionary measures · Neur.on
description: Vorsorgliche Massnahmen, Interim measures, Provvedimenti cautelari, Interim measures: Art. 261-265 CPC.

exemple.de: Das Gericht trifft die notwendigen <mark>vorsorglichen Massnahmen</mark>, wenn die gesuchstellende Partei glaubhaft macht, dass: a. ein ihr zustehender Anspruch verletzt ist oder eine Verletzung zu befürchten ist; und b. ihr aus der Verletzung ein nicht leicht wieder gutzumachender Nachteil droht.
exemple.fr: Le tribunal ordonne les <mark>mesures provisionnelles</mark> nécessaires lorsque le requérant rend vraisemblable qu’une prétention dont il est titulaire remplit les conditions suivantes: a. elle est l’objet d’une atteinte ou risque de l’être; b. cette atteinte risque de lui causer un préjudice difficilement réparable.
exemple.it: Il giudice ordina i necessari <mark>provvedimenti cautelari</mark> quando l’instante rende verosimile che: a. un suo diritto è leso o è minacciato di esserlo; e b. la lesione è tale da arrecargli un pregiudizio difficilmente riparabile.
exemple.en: The court shall order the <mark>interim measures</mark> required provided the applicant shows credibly that: a. a right to which he or she is entitled has been violated or a violation is anticipated; and b. the violation threatens to cause not easily reparable harm to the applicant.

resume: The supreme judicial authority of the Confederation, which is based in Lausanne and Lucerne.
lead: The same judgment of the Federal Supreme Court is cited ATF in French, BGE in German and DTF in Italian. English has no official acronym.
definition: The Federal Supreme Court is the supreme judicial authority of the Confederation. He sits in Lausanne; his law courses are in Lucerne. In particular, it decides on appeals in civil, criminal and public law matters. Its judgments published in the Official Compilation refer to ATF in French, BGE in German and DTF in Italian.
title: Bundesgericht: the Swiss Federal Supreme Court · Neur.on
description: Bundesgericht, Federal Supreme Court, Federal Supreme Court: the supreme judicial authority of the Confederation.

exemple.de: Das <mark>Bundesgericht</mark> ist die oberste rechtsprechende Behörde des Bundes.
exemple.fr: Le <mark>Tribunal fédéral</mark> est l’autorité judiciaire suprême de la Confédération.
exemple.it: Il <mark>Tribunale federale</mark> è l’autorità giudiziaria suprema della Confederazione.
exemple.en: The <mark>Federal Supreme Court</mark> is the supreme judicial authority of the Confederation.

resume: The natural person who ultimately controls or benefits from the assets.
lead: The beneficial owner is at the heart of the due diligence obligations of Swiss banks: behind every account you need to know who is actually being served.
definition: The financial intermediary must identify the beneficial owner with due care in the circumstances. It shall obtain from its contracting partner a written declaration as to who is the beneficial owner of the assets. For an operating legal entity, it shall identify the natural persons who ultimately control it. In case of doubt, the identification must be repeated.
title: Beneficial owner: the concept of AMLA · Neur.on
description: wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person, beneficial owner, economicamente diritto, beneficial owner: the identification required by AMLA Article 4.

exemple.de: Der Finanzintermediär muss mit der nach den Umständen gebotenen Sorgfalt die <mark>wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person</mark> feststellen und deren Identität überprüfen, um sich zu vergewissern, wer die wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person ist.
exemple.fr: L’intermédiaire financier doit, avec la diligence requise par les circonstances, identifier l’<mark>ayant droit économique</mark> et vérifier son identité, afin de s’assurer de savoir qui est l’ayant droit économique.
exemple.it: L’intermediario finanziario deve, con la diligenza richiesta dalle circostanze, accertare l’<mark>avente economicamente diritto</mark> e verificarne l’identità, per assicurarsi di sapere chi è l’avente economicamente diritto.
exemple.en: The financial intermediary must identify the <mark>beneficial owner</mark> with the due diligence required in the circumstances and verify its identity in order to ensure that it knows who the beneficial owner is.

resume: The obligations that the money Laundering Act imposes on financial intermediaries before and during the business relationship.
lead: The AMLA's due diligence obligations are described in precise terms: identify, verify, clarify, document. They precede the obligation to report.
definition: The Anti-money Laundering Act imposes duties of due diligence on financial intermediaries: verify the identity of the contracting partner, identify the beneficial owner, repeat these verifications in case of doubt, clarify the background and purpose of unusual transactions or business relationships, and retain the documents. These obligations are in addition to the obligation to report well-founded suspicions to the money Laundering reporting Office Switzerland.
title: Sorgfaltspflichten: due diligence obligations · Neur.on
description: Sorgfaltspflichten, duties of due diligence, obblighi di diligenza, due diligence obligations: the duties of financial intermediaries (AMLA).

exemple.de: Der Finanzintermediär kann auf die Einhaltung der <mark>Sorgfaltspflichten</mark> (Art. 3-7) verzichten, wenn die Geschäftsbeziehung nur Vermögenswerte von geringem Wert betrifft und keine Verdachtsmomente für mögliche Geldwäscherei oder Terrorismusfinanzierung vorliegen.
exemple.fr: L’intermédiaire financier n’est pas tenu de respecter les <mark>obligations de diligence</mark> (art. 3 à 7) si la relation d’affaires porte uniquement sur des valeurs patrimoniales de faible valeur et qu’il n’y pas d’indices de blanchiment d’argent ou de financement du terrorisme.
exemple.it: L’intermediario finanziario può rinunciare ad adempiere gli <mark>obblighi di diligenza</mark> (art. 3-7) se la relazione d’affari concerne soltanto valori patrimoniali di poca entità e se non vi sono elementi di sospetto di un eventuale riciclaggio di denaro o finanziamento del terrorismo.
exemple.en: The financial intermediary may dispense with complying with the <mark>duties of due diligence</mark> (Art. 3-7) if the business relationship only involves assets of low value and there is no suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing.

source: Fedlex, Federal Act on direct Federal taxation
resume: An offence by a taxpayer who wilfully or negligently causes a tax to be omitted or incomplete.
lead: Tax evasion is punishable by a fine. It does not confuse itself with tax fraud (Steuerbetrug), which presupposes the use of forged documents.
definition: Any taxpayer who wilfully or negligently causes a tax not to be assessed when it is due or if a legally binding tax is incomplete shall be liable to a fine. As a rule, the fine is equal to the amount of the tax evaded; it may be reduced to a third in the case of minor negligence or tripled in the case of gross negligence.
title: Steuerhinterziehung: tax evasion · Neur.on
description: Steuerhinterziehung, tax evasion, sottrazione d' imposta, tax evasion: the violation of Art. 175 DFTA and its difference with tax evasion.

exemple.de: Zeigt die steuerpflichtige Person erstmals eine <mark>Steuerhinterziehung</mark> selbst an, so wird von einer Strafverfolgung abgesehen (straflose Selbstanzeige), wenn: a. die Hinterziehung keiner Steuerbehörde bekannt ist; b. sie die Verwaltung bei der Festsetzung der Nachsteuer vorbehaltlos unterstützt; und c. sie sich ernstlich um die Bezahlung der geschuldeten Nachsteuer bemüht.
exemple.fr: Lorsque le contribuable dénonce spontanément et pour la première fois une <mark>soustraction d’impôt</mark>, il est renoncé à la poursuite pénale (dénonciation spontanée non punissable), à condition: a. qu’aucune autorité fiscale n’en ait connaissance; b. qu’il collabore sans réserve avec l’administration pour déterminer le montant du rappel d’impôt; c. qu’il s’efforce d’acquitter le rappel d’impôt dû.
exemple.it: Se il contribuente denuncia spontaneamente per la prima volta una <mark>sottrazione d’imposta</mark>, si prescinde dall’aprire un procedimento penale (autodenuncia esente da pena), a condizione che: a. la sottrazione d’imposta non sia nota ad alcuna autorità fiscale; b. egli aiuti senza riserve l’amministrazione a determinare l’ammontare dell’imposta sottratta; e c. si adoperi seriamente per pagare l’imposta dovuta.

source: Fedlex, Federal Act on direct Federal taxation
resume: The tax levied directly on the salary of certain employees by their employer.
lead: Withholding tax should not be confused with withholding tax: withholding tax is levied on the income from the activity of certain workers, while withholding tax is levied on capital income.
definition: Foreign workers who do not hold a permanent residence permit but who are resident or resident in Switzerland are subject to withholding tax on income from their employment. The employer withholds the salary tax and pays it to the tax authority. Some people domiciled abroad, such as cross-border commuters or members of boards of directors, are also subject to the regulations.
title: Quellensteuer: Swiss withholding tax · Neur.on
description: Quellensteuer, withholding tax, imposta alfonte, withholding tax: the withholding made by the supplier (Art. 83 et seq. DFTA).

exemple.de: Arbeitnehmer ohne Niederlassungsbewilligung, die in der Schweiz jedoch steuerrechtlichen Wohnsitz oder Aufenthalt haben, unterliegen für ihr Einkommen aus unselbstständiger Erwerbstätigkeit einer <mark>Quellensteuer</mark>.
exemple.fr: Les travailleurs sans permis d’établissement qui sont domiciliés ou en séjour en Suisse au regard du droit fiscal sont soumis à un <mark>impôt à la source</mark> sur le revenu de leur activité lucrative dépendante.
exemple.it: I lavoratori senza permesso di domicilio che hanno domicilio o dimora fiscale in Svizzera sono assoggettati a un’<mark>imposta alla fonte</mark> per il loro reddito da attività lucrativa dipendente.
